row:
At White Integrated Health Clinics we are dedicated to helping you achieve your health goals to improve your quality of life!

We have two clinic locations: our River Oaks location (https://www.riveroakschiropracticclinic.com/), and our Waterside location (https://www.healthcarewaterside.com/)

Combining the skills and expertise of Chiropractic and wellness care, Dr. Dale White Jr. D.C.,  and the White Integrated Health Clinics Team are committed to bringing Fort Worth, TX better health naturally by teaching and practicing the true principles of Chiropractic and the wellness lifestyle.

When you choose White Integrated Health Clinics you are assured of receiving personalized care through the use of modern Chiropractic equipment and technology. Our Chiropractors and Family Nurse Practitioner and the White Integrated Health Clinics Team have a genuine concern for your well-being!
